Visit note | 2025-08-03 02:00 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Sultana Molla, 74, female. Mrs. Molla returns for review and reports she has no symptoms, though she has a family history of a father who had a heart attack at 55. She works as a tailor and notes this was found after a relative's heart attack in Barishal prompted testing. She has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She reports taking her prescribed medications regularly and denies chest pain or breathlessness. On examination: LDL cholesterol 5.1 mmol/L, BP 130/85 mmHg, pulse 79 bpm, weight 58 kg. The family noticed yellowish fatty deposits around the eyelids. Heart sounds are normal. Assessment: Dyslipidaemia. Plan: chronic follow-up: continue current medicines, no new prescription issued. She was advised to reduce fried food, red meat, and ghee, walk 30 minutes daily, and aim to lose 3 kg. Follow-up in 3 months with a repeat lipid profile.

Visit note | 2025-08-03 02:30 PM | Dr. Anisur Rahman, Ophthalmology | Patient: Bilkis Islam, 76, female. Mrs. Islam attends her review visit and describes her eyes as gritty and burning, with symptoms worse in air conditioning. She is a homemaker and mentions the trouble began after long gaming sessions at home in Sylhet. She has Essential hypertension. She reports no sudden vision loss or eye discharge. On examination: tear break-up time 7 seconds, BP 142/87 mmHg, pulse 71 bpm, weight 49 kg. Conjunctivae are slightly dry without acute inflammation. Assessment: Dry eye syndrome. Plan: chronic follow-up: continue current medicines, no new prescription issued. She was advised to look away from the screen every 20 minutes, blink often, and use a humidifier. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-08-03 03:00 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Nayeem Ahmed, 39, male.
